items.title: Earlier this weekend, the Cleveland Cavaliers signed Jaxson Robinson and Noam Yaacov to Exhibit 10 deals. Cleveland waived Curtis Jones and Kadary Richmond from their Exhibit 10 deals to create the space for Robinson and Yaacov.
